name: Fortification (Monster)
body:
You have very thick, sinewy skin that allows you to withstand serious blows.

Prerequisite: Giant subtype, natural armor bonus +8, Toughness

Benefit: When you would normally be subject to a critical hit or precision damage, there is a 25% chance that that additional damage will be ignored. You are also immune to stunning attacks.
